narrationRef.description: id into manifest.narration.entries; resolved timing drives this scene's duration

assetType.description: must match a folder name under src/assets

z.description: stacking order within a scene, resolved at runtime. Lower z paints first (further from the viewer), higher z paints last (on top). Default 0. Stable sort: assets sharing a z keep their declared order. Existing manifests are unaffected.

backgroundSpec.description: Scene background. Either a color token (e.g. 'shade1'), a literal hex string, or an object { color?, texture?, blendMode?, opacity? }. color resolves via resolveColorToken; texture resolves via resolveTextureToken (a textures.* token → public/ path).

oneOf.description: a color token (e.g. 'shade1') or a literal #RRGGBB hex string

color.description: color token or literal #RRGGBB; resolved via resolveColorToken

texture.description: texture token from styles.textures; resolved to a public/ path via resolveTextureToken

blendMode.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the texture overlay. Defaults to 'normal'.

opacity.description: opacity of the texture overlay, 0–1. Defaults to 1.

timingAnchor.description: A timing anchor for an effect/camera event. Exactly one of: offsetPercent (legacy % of scene end), relativeToAsset (asset edge ± offsetFrames), relativeToCameraAction (camera action frame ± offsetFrames). The resolver discriminates on the first-present key.

type.description: 'default' or a folder name under src/transitions

effects.description: Optional. Per-render SFX/visual effects timed against THIS scene's resolved ending frame. Timing is authored as exactly one of: `offsetPercent` (legacy — % of scene end; 0 = last frame, -10 = 90% of scene, +10 = 10% into the transition overlap), `relativeToAsset` (fire relative to an asset's enterAtFrame/exitAtFrame ± offsetFrames), `relativeToCameraAction` (fire relative to a camera action's resolved frame ± offsetFrames), or `timing` (an envelope object carrying those same keys for grouping). Omit entirely for scenes with no boundary effects.

offsetPercent.description: Legacy timing: % of scene end (0 = last frame). Optional now that alternatives exist; if absent defaults to 0.

relativeToAsset.description: id of an asset already resolved in this scene. Effect fires at that asset's enterAtFrame (or exitAtFrame when edge: 'exit') ± offsetFrames.

relativeToCameraAction.description: Index (number) or id (string) of a camera action resolved on this scene. Effect fires at that action's resolved frame ± offsetFrames.

edge.description: For relativeToAsset: which frame edge to anchor to. Defaults to 'enter'.

offsetFrames.description: Signed frames added to the resolved anchor. Defaults to 0.

timing.description: Envelope grouping the timing keys above. Mutually exclusive with authoring them flat — use whichever reads clearer.

durationInFrames.description: sfx: omit to let the clip play its natural length. visual: how long the effect asset stays mounted (default 30).

path.description: sfx only: audio file path relative to public/

assetType.description: visual only: must match a registered assetType

durationInFrames.description: Optional camera motion duration; if omitted it follows the scene duration

speed.description: Optional multiplier; >1 makes the camera move faster, <1 slower

actions.description: Optional camera sequence. Each action's `at` is between 0 and 1, representing normalized scene progress.

zoomStartPercent.description: Percentage zoom at the start of the scene; 100 means no zoom

zoomEndPercent.description: Percentage zoom at the end of the scene

zoomPercent.description: Shortcut when both start and end zoom should match

id.description: Optional stable id so timing anchors can reference this action by id (relativeToCameraAction: 'zoom1'). When omitted, index-based (0,1,…) anchoring applies.

zoomPercent.description: Zoom at this point in the camera path

cameraAnchor.description: Either a composition-frame anchor (position + percent offsets) OR an asset-follow anchor (followAssetId). When following an asset, position is omitted and the anchor resolves to the target's resolved center.

followAssetId.description: id of an asset resolved earlier in this scene's scene.assets. The camera anchor tracks that asset's center; offsetXPercent/offsetYPercent nudge from there in composition-space percent.

edge.description: Which edge of the target the anchor subscribes to. Currently purely spatial (anchor = center), reserved for future enter/exit-aware framing.
